+"""
+Loads image bytes from a value a user may control (cut image_path, character
+image, style reference, ...).
+
+Only two sources are allowed:
+- `data:` URLs, decoded in-process;
+- objects in our own storage, given either as a relative key
+  (`cuts/<id>/<uuid>.png`) or as `{STORAGE_HOST}/<key>`, read through the
+  storage client.
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request to an address taken from such a value,
+so it cannot be used to reach hosts inside our network.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+from typing import Optional
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _is_safe_key(key: str) -> bool:
+    if not key or key.startswith("/") or "\\" in key:
+        return False
+    if any(ord(c) < 0x20 or ord(c) == 0x7F for c in key):
+        return False
+    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def storage_key(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage object key `value` points to, or None if it does
+    not point into our storage."""
+    if not value or not isinstance(value, str):
+        return None
+    key = value
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and value.startswith(host + "/"):
+        key = value[len(host) + 1:]
+        # Query strings / fragments are not part of an object key.
+        key = key.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
+    elif "://" in value or value.startswith("//") or value.lower().startswith("data:"):
+        return None
+    return key if _is_safe_key(key) else None
+
+
+def _decode_data_url(value: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    header, sep, payload = value.partition(",")
+    if not sep or ";base64" not in header.lower():
+        return None
+    try:
+        return base64.b64decode(payload, validate=False)
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the bytes of the image `value` refers to, or None if it is
+    empty, not allowed, or cannot be read."""
+    if not value or not isinstance(value, str):
+        return None
+    if value[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return _decode_data_url(value)
+    key = storage_key(value)
+    if key is None:
+        logger.warning("Refusing to load image from a non-storage URL", url=value[:200])
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception as e:  # storage errors must not break callers
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image from storage", key=key[:200], error=str(e))
+        return None

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: `missing.txt` in the ZIP and an
+`X-Missing-Cuts` header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+
+def _store(key, data=PNG):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})[key] = data
+
+
+def _data_url(data=PNG):
+    return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(data).decode()
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode whose cut N (1-based) has image_paths[N-1]."""
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert project.status_code == 200, project.text
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    episode_id = ep.json()["id"]
+    for n, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        cut = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": n})
+        assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text
+        if path is not None:
+            r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": path})
+            assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def _export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r
+
+
+def _mixed_paths():
+    _store("cuts/ok/1.png")
+    return [
+        "cuts/ok/1.png",                       # 1: ok
+        None,                                  # 2: no image yet
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/",      # 3: refused address
+        "cuts/gone/4.png",                     # 4: not in storage
+        _data_url(),                           # 5: ok
+    ]
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts_in_file_and_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, _mixed_paths())
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        names = zf.namelist()
+        assert "missing.txt" in names
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+        assert sorted(n for n in names if n != "missing.txt") == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_05.png"]
+
+
+def test_webtoon_sends_missing_cuts_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    paths = _mixed_paths() + [_data_url(b"not an image")]  # 6: cannot be decoded
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, paths)
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,6"
+    assert r.content.startswith(b"\x89PNG")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_no_missing_cuts_means_no_header_and_no_file(client, fmt):
+    _store("cuts/ok/a.png")
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, ["cuts/ok/a.png", _data_url()])
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, fmt)
+
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+            assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+            assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+
+def test_header_is_exposed_to_browsers(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, ["cuts/ok/b.png", None])
+    _store("cuts/ok/b.png")
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" in r.headers["Access-Control-Expose-Headers"].lower()

+def _episode_with_cut(client, h, image_path):
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert project.status_code == 200, project.text
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    episode_id = ep.json()["id"]
+    cut = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": 1})
+    assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", INTERNAL_URLS[:3])
+def test_export_does_not_fetch_internal_urls(client, url, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode_with_cut(client, h, url)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 400
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["key", "storage_url", "data_url"])
+def test_export_zip_still_includes_storage_and_data_images(client, kind):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+
+    _store("cuts/x/panel.png")
+    image_path = {
+        "key": "cuts/x/panel.png",
+        "storage_url": f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/cuts/x/panel.png",
+        "data_url": _data_url(),
+    }[kind]
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode_with_cut(client, h, image_path)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        assert [zf.read(n) for n in zf.namelist()] == [PNG]
+
+
+def test_export_webtoon_still_uses_storage_images(client):
+    _store("cuts/y/panel.png")
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode_with_cut(client, h, "cuts/y/panel.png")
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.content.startswith(b"\x89PNG")
